export_evidence: No outbound (India-origin) shipment row was observed. All rows seen on ImportKey are inbound: "2026-02-28 | HEWLETT-PACKARD ASIA PACIFIC | HEWLETT PACKARD ENTERPRISE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | ... ARUBA 2930F 24G POE 4SFP SWCH | SINGAPORE, TAIWAN | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 85176290 | 7798845" — i.e. destination = India, not an export. Source counter: ImportKey header states "Total Shipments 34288 Records detected" / "Trading Partners 192" / "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually rendered on the free page = 5 shipment rows (all import). Export-side free views (volza, eximpedia, trademo) returned HTTP 403 and could not be read, so absence of export rows is based on the ImportKey free view only.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award or annual-report India split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable (connection refused) and Bing/Google returned only generic HP/HPE corporate pages with no tender or turnover record. No domestic supply record was actually seen — this is a retrieval gap, not a negative finding.
note: Import activity is confirmed and heavy (34,288 customs records, latest 2026-02-28, 192 counterparties, 58 ports), but it is IMPORT, not export: the company is the Indian consignee receiving HPE/Aruba networking gear from Hewlett-Packard Asia Pacific (Singapore) via Delhi Air Cargo. Declared HS 847160 (ADP input/output units) does not match the observed rows, which are 85176290 (network switches/access points), 83024900 and 39269061 — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the factual code is 85176290 for the observed networking hardware. Registered address seen on ImportKey: "24, SALARPURIA ARENA, HOSUR MAIN ROAD, ADUGODI" (Bengaluru, Karnataka) — this conflicts with the claimed state Madhya Pradesh; PAN AADCH5900Q not independently verified. No export shipments and no domestic supply evidence were found in the sources reachable within the tool budget; domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' because the relevant registries were blocked (403) and search was down. Revenue/export volume: null (not public in accessible sources).
